import pandas as pd
import glob

files = glob.glob('/workspace/CHIP_DP10_GQ20_PASS/*.xlsx')
total_variants = 0
num_samples = len(files)

exclude_keywords = ['intron', 'utr', 'intergenic', 'upstream', 'downstream']

for f in files:
    df = pd.read_excel(f, header=1)
    
    if 'In_CHIP' in df.columns:
        df = df[df['In_CHIP'] == True]
        
    if 'Sequence Ontology (Combined)' in df.columns:
        df = df.dropna(subset=['Sequence Ontology (Combined)'])
        mask = df['Sequence Ontology (Combined)'].apply(lambda x: not any(kw in str(x).lower() for kw in exclude_keywords))
        df = df[mask]
        
    total_variants += len(df)

avg_variants = total_variants / num_samples
print(f'Total variants: {total_variants}')
print(f'Number of samples: {num_samples}')
print(f'Average variants per sample: {avg_variants}')
EOF

import pandas as pd
import glob

files = glob.glob('/workspace/CHIP_DP10_GQ20_PASS/*.xlsx')
total_variants = 0
num_samples = len(files)

exclude_keywords = ['intron', 'utr', 'intergenic']
in_chip_counts = {'True': 0, 'False': 0, 'NaN': 0}

for f in files:
    df = pd.read_excel(f, header=1)
    
    if 'In_CHIP' in df.columns:
        in_chip_counts['True'] += (df['In_CHIP'] == True).sum()
        in_chip_counts['False'] += (df['In_CHIP'] == False).sum()
        in_chip_counts['NaN'] += df['In_CHIP'].isna().sum()
        df = df[df['In_CHIP'] == True]
        
    if 'Sequence Ontology (Combined)' in df.columns:
        df = df.dropna(subset=['Sequence Ontology (Combined)'])
        mask = df['Sequence Ontology (Combined)'].apply(lambda x: not any(kw in str(x).lower() for kw in exclude_keywords))
        df = df[mask]
        
    total_variants += len(df)

avg_variants = total_variants / num_samples
print(f'In_CHIP counts: {in_chip_counts}')
print(f'Total variants: {total_variants}')
print(f'Number of samples: {num_samples}')
print(f'Average variants per sample: {avg_variants}')
EOF
python3 refine_calc.py

import pandas as pd
import glob

files = glob.glob('/workspace/CHIP_DP10_GQ20_PASS/*.xlsx')
data = []

for f in files:
    df = pd.read_excel(f, header=1)
    if 'Sequence Ontology (Combined)' in df.columns and 'Effect (Combined)' in df.columns:
        df = df[df['In_CHIP'] == True]
        data.append(df[['Sequence Ontology (Combined)', 'Effect (Combined)']])

all_df = pd.concat(data)
print(pd.crosstab(all_df['Sequence Ontology (Combined)'], all_df['Effect (Combined)']))
EOF
